Match their charming chunky outlined pixel art, warm top-left light, simple joyful storybook faces. Do NOT copy their background, glow, blur or fine texture.

ONLY Harry Potter from the BOOKS HP1–HP3, about 12, absolutely no actor likeness or movie styling. Cute chibi, head 40% of standing height, thin limbs and knobbly knees, unruly jet-black hair sticking up behind, large round simple glasses, bright green eyes with pale highlight, tiny geometric nose, friendly grin, thin 2–3 pixel-block lightning scar #C75B4B on forehead. Plain emerald hand-knitted sweater WITHOUT letter, scarlet and gold striped scarf, dark trousers, brown boots. No robes.

Technical: TRUE PIXEL ART, one uniform grid of EXACT 6x6 output-pixel squares; each square one flat colour, all edges snapped to multiples of 6 measured from each cell top-left. NO antialiasing, intermediate tones, gradients, noise, glow, drop shadows, blur, soft alpha. Hard alpha 0 or 255. Outline one block thick #231F2E. At most 16 opaque colours TOTAL across entire sheet, exclusively these 16: #231F2E #4A3042 #735044 #A57554 #41465C #D6D8BF #24483F #3F6A45 #71934B #C97952 #E7AE73 #F5D69A #874056 #C75B4B #FFC36B #B7DEE0. Pale eye highlights #D6D8BF. No extra colours. Emerald effect via #24483F #3F6A45 #71934B.

Layout: exact 3 columns x 2 rows of 512x512 cells. No visible grid, captions, lettering or decorations. Each cell has >=24px empty margin; body centre local x=256. Standing hair-to-feet height 64–68 blocks (384–408 px), feet at local y=468 (approximately 470). Three-quarter dimetric view toward lower-left, same identity/size in every pose. Row 1 heads at same height and feet baseline. All poses entirely contained.
Cell 1 top-left IDLE: standing, one hand waving, smiling.
Cell 2 top-middle WALK-1: left leg steps clearly toward viewer/lower-left, right leg back; keep head height.
Cell 3 top-right WALK-2: RIGHT leg now forward, left leg back; visibly opposite silhouette from cell 2, same head height.
Cell 4 bottom-left FLY-THROW: Harry sits ASTRIDE a roughly horizontal Nimbus Two Thousand broom, polished dark wood handle pointing left, neat bound twig tail RIGHT, no lettering. His arm drawn back, holding a bright red leather Quaffle about head-size (#C75B4B with #874056 seams/shading), about to throw. Broom lowest point local y~468; whole broom fits margins.
Cell 5 bottom-middle FLY-CATCH: same broom position and scale, twigs RIGHT, Harry sits astride, BOTH hands extended forward LEFT catching the head-size red Quaffle. Clearly two arms and two legs, no duplication.
Cell 6 bottom-right SNOWBALL: standing overarm throwing a small snowball, scarf flying, happy grin. Snowball #D6D8BF with #B7DEE0 shading; not pure white or scene-only colours. Feet y468.
Prioritise book-faithful charm and readable six distinct poses, consistent large pixel grid. No photorealism or film still. Do not draw any other characters.
